text: It is truly very commendable to abhor and shun the doing any base action; but to stand in fear of every kind of censure or disrepute, may argue a gentle and open-hearted, but not a heroic temper.
author: Plutarch
locator: Comparison of Timoleon with Aemilius Paulus
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
